messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: shared-gpu-pool-3 p99 token latency > 4s for the last 6m, streaming stalls increasing. Auto-created incident INC-5987. Tags: noisy-neighbor, mt-io, streaming-stalls. @ellie you are oncall.
ellie: on it. joining. any customer-facing alerts yet?
mira: Support note — we have 2 customers reporting degraded streaming experience, one has a blocking job. Customer IDs: cust-AC12 (prod) and cust-BX33 (staging). I'll reach out if we need to page them.
sam: quick triage — is this KV cache churn or host IO? metric dashboards show KV hit rate drop and nvidia-mig metrics spike.
jamal: logs from runtime: 
```
2026-03-15T16:02:01Z runtime: stream_write stall detected, shard=pool-3 tenant=tenant-19 stall_ms=6200
2026-03-15T16:02:14Z evictor: dropped prefix cache entries=1200 tenant=tenant-19
```
looks like tenant-19 is thrashing KV cache and causing tail stalls.
ellie: thx. can infra confirm cgroup io or host-level saturation?
infra-bot: Checked hosts for pool-3. Top host hgp-07: iostat shows sustained write/s and high await; cgroup blkio for tenant-19 at 0.9 of quota. GPU memcpy bandwidth for hgp-07 ~95% for 30s window.
ops-oncall: taking host hgp-07 out of rotation for new streams (set drain on router) to reduce new sessions.
sam: good. mitigation plan propose: 1) reduce tenant-19 concurrency to 1 (soft throttle), 2) kick ongoing heavy batches with graceful evict (move caches), 3) if still bad, evacuate containers from hgp-07 to spare hosts.
mira: customer impact update: cust-AC12 has ~15% error rate on streaming transcripts, they're impacted. I'll send a status update: "We're aware of degraded streaming; investigating noisy tenant in shared GPU pool; mitigation in progress"
jamal: command to throttle tenant: 
```
# limit concurrent sessions for tenant-19 to 1
rdctl tenant update tenant-19 --concurrency=1 --reason "live mitigation noisy neighbor"
```
finished that at 16:06. observing p99 drop from 4.3s to 2.1s for 2m, but streaming stalls still intermittent.
ellie: good improvement. check KV evictor logs and host IO after throttle.
infra-bot: KV evictor rate decreased by 70% after throttle. hgp-07 blkio await still elevated -> there's background host-level writeback (possible noisy host process).
sam: any heavy disk activity (dump, snapshot) scheduled on hgp-07?
infra-bot: no planned jobs. dmesg shows occasional writeback Kswapd spikes ~16:04. host-level swap pressure maybe.
jamal: runtime traces show repeated large attention-cache writes when tenant-19 streams with long contexts (~32k tokens). That correlates with sustained GPU memcpy and host IO from cgroups backing pagecache. Seems tenant-19's long-context jobs are causing spill to host and IO churn.
ellie: options: 1) keep throttle and monitor, 2) force-evict tenant-19 to dedicated pool if customer has dedicated plan, 3) perform live evacuation (migrate tasks off hgp-07). Which is fastest?
sam: fastest is forced eviction of tenant-19's active sessions to a slower fallback model on other pool (quiet) — reduces IO spike immediately. Migration will take longer.
mira: cust-AC12 is paid-hosted, not dedicated. They are asking for ETA. I'll say 15–30m for mitigation.
ops-oncall: initiating eviction workflow: 
```
# mark tenant sessions for graceful move
rdctl session migrate --tenant tenant-19 --target-pool=pool-d-quiet --grace-period=30s
```
migration started at 16:12. rollback plan ready.
jamal: seeing abrupt drop in memcpy after migration start, host await falling. p99 back to 1.0s, streaming stalls reduced to near-0.
ellie: confirm: are there any other tenants contributing? any multi-tenant correlation?
infra-bot: scanning pool-3 kswap/io counters: tenant-19 dominated for window 16:00-16:12. No other single tenant above 10%.
sam: follow-up actions: 1) add automatic long-context detection to runtime to proactively throttle/route long contexts to dedicated lanes, 2) evaluate cgroup blkio soft-limits vs hard quotas to avoid sudden host swap pressure, 3) add a streaming stall alert tied to KV evictor rate and blkio await.
ellie: agree. add a postmortem with timeline, impact (cust-AC12 degraded streaming for ~18m), and RCA: long-context tenant causing KV thrash -> spill to host -> host writeback -> streaming stalls.
mira: customer update sent: "Mitigation applied; we're seeing recovery. Engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up with more detail." cust-AC12 acknowledged.
ops-oncall: closing immediate page: pool-3 health metrics recovered, router drain lifted at 16:22.
jamal: I'll open a follow-up ticket to propose a dedicated fallback lane for very-long-context jobs and a billing option to move heavy tenants.
ellie: thanks everyone. add owners for action items: jamal (runtime change), sam (infra cgroup tuning), mira (customer comms). I'll draft postmortem. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-5987 marked as mitigated at 16:25.
